finding: FusionDB now defers EXISTS / NOT EXISTS predicates instead of pre-materializing them into global boolean constants.
evidence: cargo test --test sql_set_subquery passed existing non-correlated EXISTS and new correlated NOT EXISTS tests.
impact: Outer-column references can be bound against the current scan/join row.

finding: Correlated NOT EXISTS works against materialized CTEs and LDBC-style comma joins.
impact: The BENCHPROD-102 blocker shape `sg y where y.link = k_person2id` is covered by regression tests.

finding: Deferred subquery filtering must run before LIMIT/OFFSET to preserve SQL semantics.
evidence: test_correlated_not_exists_filters_before_limit passed after disabling early limit/projection shortcuts for deferred subquery filters.
impact: Future optimizer work must keep correlated filters before row limiting unless it proves equivalence.

finding: Non-isolation LDBC no longer stops at `Column k_person2id not found`; it reaches Query 14 execution and times out after one operation.
evidence: ldbc_command status=gap detail=`command timed out after 180 seconds`; server log shows Q14 SQL and no `Column k_person2id not found`.
impact: Next LDBC work should profile Q14 runtime/recursion and remaining array SQL features rather than outer-column resolution.
